steps.js: window.__dmhHold = true; window.__dmh.godMode = true; window.aimAt = (E, hy=0.2) => { const g = window.__dmh, P = g.player; const eye = g.camera.position; const t = E.pos.clone(); t.y = E.pos.y + E.half*hy; const d = t.sub(eye); P.yaw = Math.atan2(-d.x, -d.z); P.pitch = Math.atan2(d.y, Math.hypot(d.x, d.z)); }; window.nearest = () => { const g = window.__dmh; let b=null, bd=1e9; for (const E of g.enemies) { if (E.dead||E.emerging) continue; const d = E.pos.distanceTo(g.player.pos); if (d<bd){bd=d;b=E;} } return b; }; 'ok'
